means: For every scored T-spin in the corpus (a T with an engine spin credit that cleared lines, inside the verified prefix, passing the reconstruction check), whether the 社畜トレイン (Shachiku Train) page's local shape stood around it: the lock's cells are the page's flat T pointing down (as drawn, or mirrored) and every cell of the window around it — the row above the T (the roof over its near end and the cell beyond it, the second slot's arms open), the two rows the TSD clears and the row under them (the cell under the nub and the S's foot filled, the second slot's nub open, the L's foot beyond it filled) — is filled or empty as drawn. The opportunity is a full T-spin Double; every hit is followed to the next T lock to see whether the second TSD the page draws fired.
not_eligible_because: simulator output: which local shape a T went into is read off the vendored Triangle engine's boards, and nothing on the corpus side has a second implementation of it. No claim id, no badge, no figure in a report.
caveat: garbage is read as FILLED inside the window, and its hole columns are the engine's seeded-RNG columns, which disagree with the recorded ones (oracle-source.ts); a hit with garbage in its window is named in garbage_in_window for that reason. At a full TSD the two cleared rows are entailed by the clear (NaiveClauseForced): the T's orientation and the rows above and below them discriminate. The page's 2x2-hole builds lead to an STSD or a TST rather than the second TSD; a hit there is still a hit, followed to the second TSD like any other. Counts only, always N / M with the denominator.
rules: opportunity: a T lock with spin "full" clearing 2 lines, at a 0-based lock index <= the verified index, whose board-before plus its cells makes exactly the rows the engine recorded clearing (the reconstruction check, counted exactly as opener-facts.json donation.check counts it)

match: the lock's cells equal the variant's flat T under one translation (mirrored: columns reflected in the window), and every other window cell is filled (a piece or garbage) or empty as the page draws it; colour is never compared; cells outside the window are not read
mirrored is tried only when as-drawn fails; a window leaving the board is no match (window_off_board)

follow-up: the page's second-TSD slot (split by the first TSD's two cleared rows until that TSD joins it) carried through every clear and garbage insertion to the next T lock, each step verified against the engine's next board; fired iff that T is the slot and a scored full TSD
controls: the same window at scored TSS, TST, mini TSS and mini TSD; ablations no_must_empty, no_roof and t_overlap at the opportunity; orientation_baseline = opportunities whose T stands up
window_rule: 0-based lock index <= 21 is in_opener (emit-opener-facts.ts's convention; emit-attack-facts.ts counts from 1)
